name: Ulrika Eku
source:
Affiliation: Edingard.

A magic blacksmith with golden eyes, the third daughter of merchant in Edingard. When Ulrika had her baptism at the Holy Church, she was told she had "Geist's Eyes". Since then her childhood was ended up taken from her and she had not seen one peaceful day. Once she gaot a little bit older, Ulrika became a member of Orva Geist, a leading group blacksmith in her continent, where her powers comes in handy.
